basic_profile.bio: A lifelong learner and tech enthusiast from Seattle, WA. I spend my days working as a software engineer and my nights exploring the intricacies of various TV shows and photography. My daughter is the light of my life, and I’m constantly finding ways to integrate technology into our daily routines to make life a tad easier. I’m a night owl, often online after 10 PM, juggling my programming projects and Reddit discussions. Married to my high school sweetheart, and we share a love for quirky TV shows and cute penguin facts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington. My expertise lies in backend development, and I’ve spent years honing my skills through both formal education and self-taught programming challenges. I keep up with technological advancements and enjoy helping others troubleshoot their tech-related issues.
